title: Finiteness of the integer cube chains with bounded coefficients on grid cells inside a compact set (parent step 2)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact, let ρ > 0 be real and let B ∈ ℕ. For p = (z, ι) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin (m+1) → Fin P) let F_p := {x ∈ ℝ^P : ρz_i ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1) for i ∈ range ι and x_i = ρz_i for i ∉ range ι}. For ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(U) let I_p(ω) := ∫_{F_p} ω(x)(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}) dH^{m+1}(x), where e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1 is the j-th standard basis vector. Let 𝒬 be the set of X ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U) for which there are a finite set s of such pairs and integers b(p) with F_p ⊆ K and |b(p)| ≤ B for every p ∈ s, and X(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} b(p)·I_p(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(U). Then 𝒬 is finite. Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For D ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(D) = TestFormOn D d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in D) and 𝒟_d(D) = GeometricCurrentOn D d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of ofReal(X(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(D) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x; M(X) = X.mass = M_D(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in D is the contract structure IMRep D d; R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x) ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHᵈ(x); R represents X when X(ω) = R.action(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(D); μ_R = R.measure = (Hᵈ⌞M).withDensity θ; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep in D represents it. For V ⊆ D, ι = testFormOnInclusion regards ω ∈ 𝒟^d(V) as an element of 𝒟^d(D) with the same underlying form, and X⌞V = X.restrictDomain (V ⊆ D) ∈ 𝒟_d(V) is given by X⌞V(ω) = X(ιω). X vanishes off a set K if X(ω) = 0 for every test form ω whose tsupport is disjoint from K.
